description: Verify that sender TCP generates a correct RFC 793 §3.1 pseudo-header checksum (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.7 p86)
approach:
[Objective]
DUT must compute checksum = ones-complement sum of pseudo-header + TCP header + payload — every emitted segment.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. DUT → Tester: data segment.
3. Observation: validate the DUT-emitted segment's checksum against its pseudo-header.

[Pass condition]
All DUT-emitted segments have valid checksums.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_bad_checksum — DUT emitted a segment with invalid checksum
• Fail_timeout — no DUT data segment within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted segment carries valid pseudo-header checksum — normal
verdicts.Fail_bad_checksum: DUT emitted segment with invalid checksum
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT data segment within listen window
